chunks: As for what is in it from al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt, I have transmitted it from my father, and Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil, and Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh; and al-Ḥusayn ibn Ibrāhīm—may Allah be pleased with them—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; one of the author’s teachers in the chain
key_terms.الرَّيَّانِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ: A narrator from whom these reports are transmitted
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ابْنِ هَاشِمٍ: A key transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: From his father; indicates the next link in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and clarifying the author’s route to this narrator.
